sources.title: NVIDIA Debuts Open Nemotron 3.5 Models for Embedding, Reranking ...
sources.snippet: NVIDIA on October 21, 2026, expanded its Nemotron Retriever collection with new open, commercially available models for embedding, reranking, and document extraction: Nemotron 3.5 Embed in 8B BF16, 1B BF16, and 1B NVFP4...

sources.title: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Embed, Rerank, and Parse: Advancing Agents with ...
sources.snippet: The new models include Nemotron 3.5 Embed 8B BF16, 1B BF16, 1B NVFP4, Nemotron 3.5 Rerank 8B BF16, and Nemotron 3.5 Parse at 631M parameters. Together, these state-of-the-art models bring multimodal retrieval, relevance ranking, and document processing to enterprise agent workflows. Better Retrieval for More Efficient Agents
